settings.industry_description: Cloud Downunder helps Australian government agencies and public sector bodies modernise legacy systems on Microsoft Azure, meeting IRAP-aligned security controls and Australian data residency requirements without disrupting citizen-facing services.

We build Azure infrastructure with role-based access, encrypted data at rest, and audit-ready logging for financial and professional services firms, so compliance obligations under Australian privacy law are handled by design, not bolted on afterward

Cloud Downunder builds secure, intelligent healthcare platforms that improve patient experiences, streamline clinical operations, and meet Australia's strict privacy and compliance requirements under the Australian Privacy Principles
We design Azure environments that auto-scale through sale periods and holiday peaks, integrate cleanly with POS and inventory systems, and keep checkout uptime high when it matters most.

We build platforms for Australian agribusinesses that sync reliably across low-bandwidth rural sites, connect farm sensor data to central dashboards, and keep field teams working through offline-capable mobile tools.

We build integrated fleet tracking and route reporting systems for Australian logistics operators, connecting real-time vehicle data to compliance reporting and cutting the manual admin around fleet management.

We connect manufacturing execution systems, IoT sensor data, and ERP platforms into a single Azure-based environment, giving operations teams one live view of production instead of five disconnected ones.

We architect Azure environments and custom .NET or cloud-native applications that scale from first customer to enterprise contract, structured so founders aren't locked into unnecessary spend early on.

settings.faq_answer: Cloud Downunder is an Australian-owned Microsoft Azure consulting and DevOps company based in Brisbane. We help startups, enterprises, and government organisations migrate to the cloud, automate software delivery pipelines, and build custom .NET and cloud-native applications, backed by more than 14 years of experience across 500+ projects.

settings.faq_question: How long does an Azure cloud migration take?
settings.faq_answer: A typical Azure migration for a small-to-medium Australian business takes 4 to 12 weeks, depending on system complexity and how much legacy infrastructure needs re-architecting rather than lift-and-shift. Enterprise and government migrations with compliance requirements usually run 3 to 6 months. We scope an exact timeline during the initial assessment, before any commitment is made.

settings.faq_question: What's the difference between DevOps and managed IT support?
settings.faq_answer: Managed IT support keeps existing systems running day to day. DevOps consulting redesigns how software gets built, tested, and deployed, using automated CI/CD pipelines so releases happen faster and with fewer errors. Cloud Downunder offers both, but most clients start with a DevOps audit to find out where delivery is actually slowing down.

settings.faq_question: Is our data stored in Australia?
settings.faq_answer: Yes. We architect Azure environments using Microsoft's Australian data centre regions (Australia East and Australia Southeast) by default, so client data stays within Australian borders and satisfies data sovereignty requirements for government, healthcare, and financial services clients specifically.

settings.faq_question: How much does Azure consulting cost in Australia?
settings.faq_answer: Cloud Downunder's rates sit around 70–150 AUD per hour depending on the complexity of the engagement, which is in line with the Australian market average for cloud consultancies. Fixed-scope projects like migrations or app builds are quoted after a free initial consultation, so there are no surprise costs once work begins.

settings.faq_question: Do you work with businesses outside Brisbane?
settings.faq_answer: Yes. While our team is based in Brisbane, we deliver Azure consulting, DevOps, and custom development remotely for clients across Australia and New Zealand, with the same data residency and compliance standards applied regardless of location.

settings.faq_question: What industries do you specialise in?
settings.faq_answer: We work most deeply with government, financial and professional services, healthcare, agriculture, retail, logistics, and manufacturing, alongside startups and scale-ups building on Azure from the ground up. Each engagement is shaped around that sector's specific compliance and uptime requirements rather than a one-size-fits-all cloud template.
